name: @deploylens/desktop
description: Local APK, AAB and IPA release-readiness inspection
author: DeployLens Contributors

scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit && esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/main.js && esbuild ../server/src/worker.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist-electron/worker.mjs && esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.package: pnpm run build:icons && pnpm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build:icons && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build:icons && pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run build:icons && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.gz
